title: Weirwright change-control evaluation flow

checks.R1: Pull request required when targeting the protected branch
checks.R2: Non-author approval; code-owner approval for sensitive paths
checks.R3: All required checks passed on the exact merged commit
checks.R4: Clean secret scan on the exact merged commit
checks.R6: Merged commit deployed, health check passed, rollback plan present

bypass_validity: approver present and not the author
post-review completed or due date not before the report date
outputs: all six rule results with evidence
limits: PASS is not a claim that the change is safe
spec_conflict: SPEC section 5 says bypass is never PASS; rules.py returns PASS when all rules pass and bypass is valid. Diagram follows rules.py.
